verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation or background agent feature in Reflect. AI prompts are invoked manually from the cmd-j palette. Kindle sync, auto-created daily notes and background transcription are fixed built-in behaviors, not automations a user sets up. Zapier is an external third-party tool, which counts as a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
